name: Sunn O)))
editorial_article: Sunn O))) is an American drone metal duo formed in Los Angeles in 1998, renowned for their extreme focus on volume, density, and sustained guitar feedback. Consisting of core members Stephen O’Malley and Greg Anderson, the band emerged from the underground as a tribute to the pioneering sludge/drone band Earth, eventually carving out a unique niche that bridges the gap between metal, experimental drone, minimalism, and contemporary composition. Their sonic signature is defined by walls of heavily amplified, slow-moving chords that favor texture and atmosphere over traditional song structure. Throughout their decades-long career, Sunn O))) has functioned as a fluid "small, mobile, intelligent unit," frequently collaborating with a diverse roster of artists including Attila Csihar, Merzbow, and Boris.\n\nBeyond their studio albums, which have evolved from the stark, ritualistic heaviness of their early work like 'The Grimmrobe Demos' and 'ØØ Void' to the more textured and orchestral arrangements of 'Monoliths & Dimensions', the band is perhaps most infamous for their immersive, high-volume live performances. Often shrouded in dry ice and robes, the group utilizes banks of Sunn amplifiers to turn their concerts into physical, visceral experiences. By challenging the listener's relationship with time and duration through drone, they have pushed the boundaries of what is considered "heavy" music, finding as much common ground with academic spectralist composition as they do with the darkest subgenres of heavy metal. Their ability to remain a vital, influential force in extreme music while maintaining an uncompromising, experimental aesthetic has solidified their status as icons of contemporary avant-garde metal.
